patternProperties.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
patternProperties.title: maxLength(2000)

propertyNames.description: a string at most 128 character(s) long
propertyNames.title: maxLength(128)

name.description: Plugin-local check name, limited to 128 characters.
name.title: maxLength(128)

preempts.description: Whether this report prevents provider construction and supersedes later checks.

running.description: Whether the checked runtime is currently running.

version.description: Optional runtime version, limited to 256 characters.
version.title: maxLength(256)

runtimeStatus.description: Optional human-readable runtime status, limited to 2,000 characters.
runtimeStatus.title: maxLength(2000)

severity.description: Diagnostic severity associated with the check outcome.

solutions.description: Zero to 16 remediation options for the reported condition.

command.description: Optional remediation command, limited to 2,000 characters.
command.title: maxLength(2000)

description.description: Redaction-aware remediation text, limited to 2,000 characters.
description.title: maxLength(2000)

kind.description: Whether the remediation can be automated or requires manual action.

solutions.title: maxItems(16)

status.description: Check outcome used by doctor summaries and exit status.
